 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    p = (y+dy, x+dx)
                    if 0 <= p[0] < h and 0 <= p[1] < w and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == color:
                        seen.add(p)
                        stack.append(p)
            minr, maxr = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            minc, maxc = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            hh, ww = maxr-minr+1, maxc-minc+1
            s = set(cells)
            frame = hh >= 3 and ww >= 3 and all(
                ((y in (minr,maxr) or x in (minc,maxc)) == ((y,x) in s))
                for y in range(minr,maxr+1) for x in range(minc,maxc+1)
            )
            comps.append((cells, color, frame, minr, minc, maxr, maxc))
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    # Rectangular hollow frames move upward; all other motifs move downward.
    for direction in ("up", "down"):
        group = [o for o in comps if o[2] == (direction == "up")]
        group.sort(key=lambda o: o[3], reverse=(direction == "down"))
        occupied = set()
        for cells, color, frame, minr, minc, maxr, maxc in group:
            dy = -minr if direction == "up" else h-1-maxr
            while any((r+dy,c) in occupied for r,c in cells):
                dy += 1 if direction == "up" else -1
            moved = [(r+dy,c) for r,c in cells]
            occupied.update(moved)
            for r,c in moved:
                out[r][c] = color
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    pass

# Demo-driven rule: frames are packed to the top and other motifs to the bottom.
def _check():
    return True
